title: Willie Smith's superstitions
summary: Young says Smith was superstitious in the Lunceford band and grew more so with James and Ellington.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Was Willie always as superstitious as I understood he was later?
Yeah, he was. He's been like that a long
time. Willie was like -- Willie was very superstitious a long time, you know.
I didn't really realize it when I knew him. I knew him when he was in Duke's band.
He didn't like to walk on a line on the sidewalk, you know. Yeah, he was always like that.
A lot of his friends said -- have told me all kinds of superstitious things.

He had a lot of hangups. He didn't have as many back there with Lunceford as he finally got later on, but he had -- he had some going for himself. Yeah, he had superstitions going, but he got an awful lot more hangups after he left Lunceford, I think. When he got with James he got more than he ever had before. And with Duke he had a lot of them too.
